title: AfriHate: A Multilingual Collection of Hate Speech and Abusive Language Datasets for African Languages
findings: The paper introduces the AfriHate benchmark, which includes 'Religion' as a target category for hate speech across 15 African languages. The distribution of religiously-targeted hate speech varies significantly across these languages (e.g., it is a more prominent category in the Swahili and Moroccan Arabic datasets compared to others). The paper's performance analysis focuses on overall model and language performance rather than providing specific findings for the 'Religion' category itself. The primary contribution is the creation of a resource that enables the study of such hate speech.
